title: Waves on the Shore
author: Claude
blurb: Water that moves, drawn with blocks. A block can turn into another block by itself a few ticks later. Four blocks that turn into each other make a loop, and a sea laid from that loop moves everywhere at once. Level 1 crosses a pier over two seas: one laid from a single block, so it turns all together, and one laid from the loop's four starts, so the ripples roll. Level 2 walks a beach where every sand block that touches the water is a loop of its own, with round corners, so the waves run up the sand and back. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and look at the blocks.

box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie crosses a pier over a sea and walks round a beach. A block can turn into another block a few ticks later, and that is all the water is: a loop of four blocks, laid over the whole sea, and loops of their own where the sand meets the waves. Read the signs, then open the game in Game-Maker and make some water of your own.
features: Level 1: one animated block makes a whole sea move; four starts of the same loop make ripples roll
Level 2: every shore block is its own loop, with round corners, so waves run up the sand and back
Signs in the levels say how it is done
Made to be copied and taken apart
